user.title: Configure Nimlykoder
user.description: Set up your Nimly lock code manager. Select your Nimly lock from the list below.

data.name: Friendly Name
data.zha_endpoint_id: ZHA Endpoint ID (only used for ZHA-managed locks)

data_description.lock_entity: Select your Nimly lock entity. Works for both Zigbee2MQTT (MQTT) and ZHA managed locks — detected automatically.
data_description.door_sensor: Optional binary sensor for the door contact (e.g. a magnetic reed switch). When set, the door's open/closed state is shown in the panel header and door events are logged in the activity log.
data_description.zha_endpoint_id: Only relevant if the lock is managed by ZHA. The Zigbee endpoint that exposes the Door Lock cluster — 11 for Nimly locks. Check Settings → Devices & Services → ZHA → your lock → Manage Zigbee device → Clusters if unsure.
data_description.slot_min: First slot number available for PIN codes (1–99, 0 is reserved)
data_description.slot_max: Last slot number available for PIN codes (1–99)
data_description.reserved_slots: Slots reserved for permanent codes (e.g. family members). Enter slot numbers separated by commas.
data_description.auto_expire: Automatically remove expired guest codes at the scheduled time
data_description.cleanup_time: Time of day when expired codes will be removed
data_description.overwrite_protection: Prevent accidental overwriting of existing codes

error.invalid_slot_range: Minimum slot must be less than maximum slot

set_auto_lock.name: Set Auto-lock
set_auto_lock.description: Enable or disable the HA-side auto-lock timer.

delay_seconds.name: Delay (seconds)
delay_seconds.description: Seconds after unlocking before the lock re-locks. Range: 5–3600. Default: 300

add_code.name: Add Code
add_code.description: Add a new PIN code to the lock

expiry.name: Expiry Date
expiry.description: Expiry date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for guest codes

slot.name: Slot Number
slot.description: Preferred slot number (optional — auto-selected if omitted)

force.name: Force Overwrite
force.description: Overwrite the slot even if it is already occupied

remove_code.name: Remove Code
remove_code.description: Remove a PIN code from the lock

update_expiry.name: Update Expiry
update_expiry.description: Update the expiry date of an existing code

expiry.name: Expiry Date
expiry.description: New expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), or leave empty to remove the expiry

update_name.name: Update Name
update_name.description: Update the display name of a code entry

update_pin.name: Update PIN Code
update_pin.description: Replace the PIN code for an existing slot. Warning: the old code cannot be retrieved.

cleanup_expired.name: Cleanup Expired Codes
cleanup_expired.description: Manually remove all expired guest codes from the lock and storage
